# Teradata Symbol Logo - Optimized Base64 for Web Embedding

Per brand guidelines: **NEVER recreate the logo programmatically** - always use the provided official assets.

**The default choice should always be to use the PNG files directly** (`teradata_logo_rgb_pos.png` or `teradata_sym_rgb_pos.png`). Only use the base64-encoded version below when the environment requires embedded images (e.g., single-file React artifacts, data URIs).

---

## Symbol Logo ("t." mark)

**Source:** `teradata_sym_rgb_pos.png`  
**Optimized size:** 64px wide (~1.5KB)  
**Use case:** Icons, favicons, dashboard headers, compact spaces, single-file web components

### Base64 Data URI

```
data:image/png;base64,
```

### Usage in React/JSX

```jsx
// Symbol logo for icons and compact spaces
const TERADATA_LOGO = "data:image/png;base64,";

// Usage in component
<img src={TERADATA_LOGO} alt="Teradata" className="h-8 w-auto" />
```

### Usage in HTML

```html
<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Teradata" height="32" />
```

---

## When to Use Base64 vs PNG Files

| Scenario | Recommendation |
|----------|----------------|
| Standard web pages | Use PNG file (`<img src="assets/teradata_sym_rgb_pos.png">`) |
| React/Vue/Angular apps with bundler | Use PNG file (bundler handles optimization) |
| Single-file React artifacts | Use base64 (no external file access) |
| Email templates | Use base64 (ensures logo displays) |
| Inline SVG not possible | Use base64 |
| Data URIs required | Use base64 |

**Note:** The full wordmark logo (`teradata_logo_rgb_pos.png`) is too large for practical base64 embedding. Always use the PNG file directly for the wordmark.
